name: Maybell Maclure
summary: At the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest, Maybell Maclure loves a Stonefield in secret. Her family’s bitter feud with the neighboring Stonefields keeps her apart from Tommy Joe Stonefield.

sections.title: Star-Crossed in the Vineyards
sections.body: Maybell Maclure works the family vineyards under the shadow of a long feud with the Stonefields next door. She has fallen in love with Tommy Joe Stonefield, heir to the rival farm. Their relatives keep them apart, and Maybell searches for a way to speak with him beyond her family’s watchful eyes.

sections.title: A Concoction for True Love
sections.body: Unable to cross between the farms openly, Maybell turns to sympathetic travelers and Gramma Stonefield for help. William Pestle, Goldshire’s alchemist, brews an invisibility liquor. Maybell drinks it to slip away from the Maclure homestead unseen and meet Tommy Joe by the riverbank.

faq.q: Why can't Maybell and Tommy Joe see each other?
faq.answer: The Maclure and Stonefield families have kept a bitter rivalry for years. Both forbid contact between their households, so Maybell and Tommy Joe hide their romance from their kin.

faq.q: What prevents Maybell from leaving the vineyard?
faq.answer: Maybell’s family watches her closely because of the feud with the Stonefields. She needs help meeting Tommy Joe without drawing their attention.

faq.q: Where does Maybell meet Tommy Joe?
faq.answer: Tommy Joe waits by the riverbank on the border between the Maclure Vineyards and Stonefield Farm, out of direct view of both farmsteads.

faq.q: Who helps Maybell with her romance?
faq.answer: Gramma Stonefield sympathizes with the lovers and directs willing travelers to William Pestle, the alchemist in Goldshire, who provides what they need for a secret meeting.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers crossing Elwynn Forest, Maybell’s romance shows how personal troubles and old grudges persist in the kingdom’s heartlands.
